## Purpose and scope

Link the public issue and, for research, the frozen specification/source result.
State whether this is code, data quality, replication, negative result or documentation.

## Evidence and results

Describe what was executed versus inspected. Link permitted machine-readable
aggregates, source identities, commands, parameters and limitations. A failed or
inconclusive research result is valid; do not claim profitability from software tests.

## Verification

- Commands executed and environment:
- Passing/failing/skipped tests:
- Checks not executed and exact blockers:
- Source/metric/figure consistency checks:

## Review checklist

- [ ] Baseline, units, dates, vintage and evidence type are explicit where relevant.
- [ ] Exploratory changes and all tried variants are disclosed.
- [ ] Missing observations remain missing; synthetic data is labelled.
- [ ] No private data, credentials or restricted vendor histories are published.
- [ ] No required check is bypassed; unexecuted checks are not called passing.
- [ ] No live trading, model promotion or paid resources are implicitly enabled.

See the [contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and
[research review checklist](../docs/contributing/review.md).
